svg.font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', Aptos, Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: From a fixed regional pair to an adaptable multi-region platform
svg.desc: Left: two mirrored full-platform regions (primary and DR) under one governance model. Right: regions as qualified options with different Platform Services profiles — full, minimal, remote, governance-only and candidate — all under one governed operating model.
svg.text: Works while demand and placement remain predictable; becomes less
Qualify additional regions and adopt only the platform capabilities each workload needs, while keeping one governed
